title: Design & write wave config JSON (waves.json)
description: Design and write assets/data/waves.json defining 20+ waves with escalating difficulty. Each wave entry: enemy type, count, spawn interval, special modifiers (fast, armored, flying). Include a boss wave every 5 waves. WaveManager consumes this file.
acceptance_criteria: waves.json valid JSON with 20+ entries; boss appears at wave 5/10/15/20; WaveManager parses all entries without error.

title: Implement SkillSystem & SkillSelectOverlay
description: After each wave, pause the game and show SkillSelectOverlay: a Flutter widget presenting 3 randomly drawn skills. Player picks one, which applies a permanent buff for the run. Define 15+ skills (e.g. +dmg, +range, +gold, split arrow). SkillSystem tracks active skills and applies buffs to towers.
acceptance_criteria: Overlay appears after each wave; 3 skills shown randomly from pool; selected skill modifies tower stats; 15+ skills defined.

title: Implement MergeSystem logic & animation
description: MergeSystem.tryMerge() detects when a dragged tower lands on an identical type+level tower. On match: remove both, spawn evolved tower, play merge animation (scale pulse + particle burst). Define the full merge tree up to level 5 for each tower type.
acceptance_criteria: Level 1+1 merges into level 2; merge animation plays; wrong-type drops are rejected; merge tree defined up to level 5.

title: Implement WaveManager & fort health system
description: WaveManager reads assets/data/waves.json to spawn enemy sequences with timing gaps. Fort tracks current HP; enemies that reach the fort deal damage. HP reaching 0 triggers game over. Implement wave-complete detection to advance to next wave.
acceptance_criteria: Wave 1 spawns from JSON; fort HP decreases when enemies breach; game over fires when HP=0; wave counter increments.

title: Implement projectile & collision detection
description: Build the Arrow and Cannonball projectile components using Flame's hitbox system. Projectiles travel toward their target, deal damage on hit, and are returned to the object pool on impact. CannonBall deals splash damage in a radius.
acceptance_criteria: Arrows hit single target and despawn; cannonballs deal splash; object pool recycles projectiles without memory leak.

title: Implement tower attack logic
description: Each BaseTower subclass must: detect enemies within attack range, select the highest-priority target (furthest along path), fire a projectile at configurable fire rate, and display an attack animation. Implement for ArcherTower and CannonTower.
acceptance_criteria: Tower fires at enemies in range; stops when no enemies in range; fire rate and damage are per-tower-type configurable.

title: Implement A* pathfinding for enemies
description: Implement A* pathfinding in utils/astar_pathfinding.dart. Enemies must navigate around grid obstacles and tower placements to reach the fort. Recalculate paths when towers are placed or removed. Use the grid cell coordinates as nodes.
acceptance_criteria: Enemies reroute when a tower blocks their current path; pathfinding completes within one frame for a 10×8 grid.

title: Generate enemy sprite sheets with ludo.ai
description: Use ludo.ai MCP to generate sprite sheets for enemy types: Goblin, Orc, Troll, Dark Knight, Boss Dragon. Each needs walk animation (4–8 frames) and death animation. Style: medieval fantasy pixel art. Export into assets/images/sprites/enemies/.
acceptance_criteria: 5 enemy types with walk+death animation strips in assets/images/sprites/enemies/; consistent art style.

title: Generate tower sprite sheets with ludo.ai
description: Use ludo.ai MCP to generate sprite sheets for all tower types: Archer Tower, Cannon Tower, Magic Tower, Trap (levels 1–3 each). Style: medieval fantasy pixel art, top-down view. Export as PNG spritesheets into assets/images/sprites/towers/.
acceptance_criteria: All tower sprite PNGs present in assets folder; sprites have consistent pixel art style; at least 3 tower types × 3 levels.

title: Implement tower drag-and-drop placement
description: Allow players to drag tower icons from a sidebar/shop UI and drop them onto empty grid cells. Handle invalid drops (occupied cell, insufficient gold). Show a ghost preview while dragging.
acceptance_criteria: Dragging a tower over the grid shows a ghost; dropping on empty cell places the tower; occupied cells reject the drop.

title: Implement GridBoard component
description: Build the GridBoard Flame component that renders an N×M grid of cells on screen. Cells should be evenly spaced, touch-responsive, and visually distinct (empty vs. occupied). This is the core UI surface for tower placement.
acceptance_criteria: GridBoard renders at correct screen position; N and M are configurable; each cell is tappable.

title: Phase 3: Merge + Roguelike Systems
description: Implement the merge mechanic (drag same-level towers together to evolve), roguelike skill selection between waves, and wave data configuration. Depends on Phase 2.
acceptance_criteria: Two level-1 towers merge into level-2; skill selection overlay appears between waves; 10+ waves defined in JSON with varied enemies.

title: Phase 2: Combat Core
description: Implement all combat mechanics: enemy pathfinding (A*), tower targeting and firing, projectile collision, wave spawning manager, and fort health. Depends on Phase 1.
acceptance_criteria: Enemies walk from spawn to fort; towers fire and hit enemies; fort HP decreases on breach; wave 1 config spawns correctly.

title: Phase 1: Basic Framework
description: Foundation of the game: grid system, basic tower rendering, and drag-and-drop placement. This epic must be completed before any combat or merge logic can begin.
acceptance_criteria: Grid renders N×M cells on screen; towers can be placed on cells via drag; sprites load without errors; flutter run shows the grid.

title: Generate UI & background art with ludo.ai
description: Use ludo.ai MCP (createImage) to generate: (1) main_menu_bg.png — epic medieval castle panorama; (2) skill_card_bg.png — parchment scroll texture for skill cards; (3) grid_tile.png — stone floor tile for grid cells; (4) fort_sprite.png — castle/fort building. Export into assets/images/sprites/ui/ and tilemaps/.
acceptance_criteria: 4 art assets present in correct folders; assets are high-res (at minimum 512×512); consistent medieval fantasy style.

title: Implement game over & victory screens
description: Build GameOverScreen and VictoryScreen Flutter widgets shown as overlays on the GameWidget. Game over shows final wave reached, score, and retry/menu buttons. Victory screen shows after surviving all waves. Both screens must stop game loop and BGM.
acceptance_criteria: Game over overlay appears when fort HP=0; victory overlay after wave 20; retry restarts game; menu returns to HomeScreen.

title: Integrate flame_audio (SFX + BGM)
description: Wire all generated audio files into the game using flame_audio. BGM: loop gameplay_bgm on game start, switch tracks on menu/victory/game-over screens. SFX: trigger each sound effect from the appropriate game event (tower fire, enemy death, merge, etc.). Handle audio focus on Android/iOS.
acceptance_criteria: All SFX trigger at correct game events; BGM loops on gameplay screen; music stops/changes on game over.

title: Generate background music with ludo.ai
description: Use ludo.ai MCP (createMusic) to generate: (1) main_menu.ogg — epic medieval fanfare, 60s loop; (2) gameplay_bgm.ogg — tense medieval battle underscore, 120s loop; (3) victory.ogg — triumphant sting, 10s; (4) game_over.ogg — somber defeat theme, 10s. Export into assets/audio/bgm/.
acceptance_criteria: 4 BGM files in assets/audio/bgm/; gameplay track loops seamlessly; all tracks have appropriate mood.

title: Generate SFX set with ludo.ai
description: Use ludo.ai MCP (createSoundEffect) to generate the following SFX: arrow_shoot, cannon_fire, enemy_death_small, enemy_death_large, merge_success, skill_select, tower_place, fort_hit, game_over, wave_complete. Export as OGG/MP3 into assets/audio/sfx/.
acceptance_criteria: 10 named SFX files present in assets/audio/sfx/; each audio file plays correctly via flame_audio.

title: Implement explosion & merge particle effects
description: Add visual polish with Flame's ParticleSystemComponent: (1) explosion burst on enemy death (orange/yellow sparks), (2) merge shimmer effect (gold particles rising from merged cell), (3) tower level-up glow ring. Particles must be pooled and not cause frame drops.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct particle effects play at correct moments; no observable FPS drop when 5+ particles fire simultaneously.

title: Implement HUD overlay (wave/HP/gold/speed)
description: Build HudOverlay Flutter widget connected to game state via Provider. Displays: current wave number, fort HP bar, gold counter, and 1×/2×/3× speed buttons. Speed button calls game.speed = 1|2|3 via FlameGame timescale. Position at top of screen without blocking gameplay area.
acceptance_criteria: All 4 HUD elements visible during play; speed buttons change game speed; HP bar updates in real-time; gold counter increments on kill.

title: Phase 5: Optimization & Release
description: Performance tuning (object pooling, culling), meta-progression persistence (Hive), ad integration, and final Android/iOS QA builds. Depends on Phase 4.
acceptance_criteria: 60 fps on mid-range Android with 30+ enemies; Hive saves progress; ads show correctly; release APK and IPA build without errors.

title: Phase 4: UI, Audio & Visual Polish
description: Complete the player-facing layer: HUD overlays, particle effects, speed controls, SFX/BGM integration, game over/victory screens, and all generated game assets. Depends on Phase 3.
acceptance_criteria: HUD shows live wave/HP/gold; explosions have particles; BGM plays; game over screen shows; all ludo.ai-generated assets are integrated.

title: Android & iOS QA builds
description: Produce signed release builds for both platforms. Android: configure keystore, build release APK and AAB. iOS: configure provisioning profile and code signing, build IPA. Run smoke test on physical Android and iOS devices: full game start to game-over without crash.
acceptance_criteria: flutter build apk --release and flutter build ipa succeed; game plays end-to-end on real Android and iOS device.

title: Integrate google_mobile_ads (interstitial + rewarded)
description: Integrate google_mobile_ads: show an interstitial ad on game over, and offer a rewarded ad button in skill selection ('Watch ad for extra choice'). Use test ad unit IDs in debug mode. Ensure ads don't interrupt active gameplay. Handle failed ad loads gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: Interstitial fires on game over; rewarded ad button appears in skill select; test ads show in debug build; no crash on ad load failure.

title: Implement Hive meta-progression persistence
description: Use hive_flutter to persist: highest wave reached, total gold earned, unlocked tower types, and lifetime stats. Initialize Hive in main(), register TypeAdapters for model classes. Expose a ProgressionRepository that the HomeScreen and GameScreen read/write.
acceptance_criteria: Stats persist across app restarts; new run reads correct unlocked towers; TypeAdapters registered without error.

title: Object pool & performance optimization
description: Profile the game on a mid-range Android device. Implement ObjectPool<T> for: projectiles, damage number labels, and particle emitters. Add view-frustum check so off-screen enemies skip AI update ticks. Target: stable 60 fps with 30+ simultaneous enemies.
acceptance_criteria: Profiler shows GC pauses <2ms; 60fps maintained at 30 enemies on Pixel 4a; object pool hit rate >80%.
